pundit.name: Eric Wynalda
pundit.take:
**Gunner's on top, schooling these clowns while the "Noisemaker" drafts like he's never watched a match.** Listen, folks, Gunner, or should I say "Bubba G," is making everyone else look like they're playing checkers while he's playing chess. France and Morocco making waves? No surprise there. He's got 63 points, blowing everyone else out of the water. Meanwhile, "The Noisemaker," Rafe, drafted Germany, Ecuador, and Mexico, and still sits dead last with 29 points. It's almost like he picked teams based on how they sound in FIFA rather than actual soccer prowess. 

Today's Brazil vs. Norway matchup is a prime example of "Mustard Boy" Zach's clueless drafting style. Brazil should wipe the floor with Norway, leaving Devin's "Ghost Pepper" fantasy dreams in the dust. And don't get me started on Mexico vs. England. Gayden, the so-called "Backpass Assassin," might've picked England, but you'd think he'd know better than to pin hopes on Japan and the Ivory Coast. England will absolutely dismantle Mexico, and Rafe will be left wishing he had focused on his homework instead of dreaming up this disaster of a lineup.

pundit_takes.headline: Gunner Secures Top Spot With France And Morocco Wins
pundit_takes.subtitle: Avoids upsets through zero risk and even less creativity.

pundit_takes.headline: Mustard Boy's Brazil Poised To Challenge Ghost Pepper's Norway
pundit_takes.subtitle: Both managers equally confident after thoroughly Googling 'soccer strategies'.

pundit_takes.headline: Rafe's Mexico Set To Face England In High-Stakes Showdown
pundit_takes.subtitle: The Noisemaker reportedly plans to make noise if Mexico scores.

pundit_takes.headline: Zach Slides To Third As Gunner's Teams Dominate The Field
pundit_takes.subtitle: Thanks to his draft strategy: hope and mustard seeds.
